0022600167.text: Boston comes in at 5-1, second in the Atlantic and third in the East, while Houston is 6-1, second in the Southwest and second in the West, and the Rockets are riding a win streak. The Celtics are without Devin Carter (illness) and Mitchell Robinson (rest), and the Rockets are missing Steven Adams (calf strain), with Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Reed Sheppard (back) both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Boston's 114-93 win in Houston on February 4, 2026 the most recent meeting.
